title: Completed strict henselization is flat over the base
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local commutative ring with maximal ideal n, let A^{\mathrm{sh}} be its strict henselization with respect to a separable closure of its residue field, and let T=\varprojlim_r A^{\mathrm{sh}}/(nA^{\mathrm{sh}})^r be its maximal-ideal completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Then the canonical ring map A\to T is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LJ (lemma-henselization-noetherian), proof part (c), paragraph beginning 'To finish the proof of (c)'

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-strict-henselization-mod-power-free] to obtain a set X and an A-linear equivalence E from the n-adic completion of F = X →₀ A to T. The module F is free and hence flat (Mathlib Module.Flat.finsupp). By [lem-weil-pbc-flat-module-completion-flat], its completion is flat over the completed base ring. The completed base ring is flat over A by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-completion-flat]. Restrict scalars using Module.Flat.trans, the module form of [lem-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map-comp], to conclude that the completion of F is flat over A. Transfer this flatness along E using Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv E.symm, and convert it into flatness of the canonical algebra map using RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff. Only A-linearity of E is required: no completed-base action on T or completed-base linearity of E needs to be established.
